title: The g61 system fixes of the seven questions hold (no English left on FULL, author words, Joomla plugin/date/layout words, glyph fallback, template buttons, distinct post titles, EmDash seed languages and form words, built-site audit, fonts readiness) and ship with their releases: Claude Cowork for Joomla 0.24.13, Tracy Business EmDash 1.7.9, Tracy SaaS EmDash 1.4.6 pinned, contract ja-essence/wp7/1.0.14 for theme 1.0.14
steps: S1: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/{joomla-left-english,brief-wp-labels-left,brief-wp-repeated-names,author-words,joomla-author-words,brief-wordpress,joomla-site-words,glyph-fallback}.test.mjs (models that answer wrong: English kept, lines missing, formats turned into words).

S3: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/emdash-tool.test.mjs, the Business theme's tests/{personalize-demo-files-seed,seed-language-leftovers}.test.mjs and tests/form-embed-words.test.mjs of the Business, SaaS and Base EmDash themes.
S5: read both quickstarts.json: every Joomla pin's Claude Cowork version, and the tracy-business/emdash and tracy-saas/emdash entries.

S6: read packages/cms/tracy-wordpress-quickstart/contracts/ja-essence/wp7/1.0.14/{manifest,content-map,presentation-lock}.json against 1.0.13's, and the quickstart/ja-essence/wp7 1.0.14 row of template-profiles.json.
expect: S1: every test passes, none skipped or cancelled.
S2: every test passes, none skipped or cancelled.
S3: every test passes, none skipped or cancelled.
S4: every test passes, none skipped or cancelled.
S5: every Joomla pin on Claude Cowork 0.24.13; tracy-business/emdash 1.7.9 and tracy-saas/emdash 1.4.6, source and state files named for that version with a GitHub asset id.

S6: contract id ja-essence/wp7/1.0.14, quickstart version 1.0.14, content map identical to 1.0.13, the lock differs from 1.0.13 only in inc/extra.php, the eight languages/*.l10n.php, readme.txt and style.css (template parts and entities identical); the profile row says logos pair, brandReady.
fence: The language, button and post-title fallbacks every engine takes when the model disobeys, the EmDash seed and form words, the built-site audit and fonts readiness, and the releases this repository pins for them.
